applicant.name: Prof. Martin Gruber
applicant.organisation: Johannes Kepler University, Institute of Respiratory Care Research

purpose: We study inhaler treatment of COPD patients across Austria for a scientific publication.
question: How many patients with COPD currently use a long-acting inhaler, per region?
definitions: COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Long-acting inhaler = active prescription with ATC code starting with R03.
Report per region: patients with COPD, those with an active long-acting inhaler, and the percentage, one decimal.
